shortDescription: Swiss security group Dormakaba BX:DOKA received U.S. tariff refunds in a low- to mid-single-digit million-dollar amount during its 2025/26 financial year, company executives said on Tuesday after it reported in-line annual results.Talking to analysts after the earnings release, CEO Till Reuter and…

children: received U.S. tariff refunds in a low- to mid-single-digit million-dollar amount during its 2025/26 financial year, company executives said on Tuesday after it reported in-line annual results.

Talking to analysts after the earnings release, CEO Till Reuter and CFO Rene Peter said the refunds should be viewed as a recovery of costs the group had incurred from various U.S. tariffs and related supply chain disruptions, rather than money collected from customers through tariff-related price increases.

A U.S. court filing showed last month that President Donald Trump's administration had refunded about $100 billion in tariffs and interest following a Supreme Court ruling that struck down the duties.
